tasks.title: Control C1 dispersion test and independent dof/attenuation recomputation

handoff.objective: TWO tasks, both zero new sampling. (A) CONTROL C1: build a properly constructed deep-tail Poisson dispersion test -- local smooth rate rather than plug-in lambda, leverage correction, windows binned to EXPECTED COUNT >= 10, and phi reported WITH ITS OWN STANDARD DEVIATION so the reader can tell signal from noise. EV-MLKEM-0cf1df S-11 records two prior attempts that disagree in opposite directions (0.20-0.81 biased low; 1.27-2.72 biased high); this decides whether ANY absolute reading in the deep tail, favourable or adverse, is interpretable, and hence whether the observation that every model sits 16-42 percent below the deep-tail floor means anything. (B) INDEPENDENTLY RECOMPUTE the two quantities on which this goal has just retired its main statistic: O-1's effective degrees of freedom (reported 1.55 and 1.51 under the D-1 covariance min(1/lambda,1/lambda')) and O-2's attenuation identity (reported ratio^2 = 0.5919 + (measurable misfit variance)/209.126, implying a perfect model reads 0.769x). Derive both from the archived data yourself before reading how the red team did it.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the deep-tail residuals carry information at all, and whether the decision to retire the whole-band statistic rests on arithmetic that a second party reproduces. Both the dof number and the attenuation identity have been computed exactly once, by the party that proposed retiring the statistic.
